$comment: Cover-sheet spec only. The component inventory — ids, sections, groups, captions and variants — lives next to the @Previews as @CatalogGroup / @CatalogComponent / @CatalogVariant annotations under glimmer-catalog/src/main/kotlin/ee/schimke/m3catalog/glimmer/, exactly as the sibling :catalog does. `referenceKits` names the community Glimmer kit this sheet is compared against — a COMMUNITY file rather than a first-party one, which is why `.design-parity.json`'s repo-wide `design-led` direction is worth revisiting for this system specifically (see docs/design/GLIMMER.md). There is no `compareWith`: this sheet is rasterised by Robolectric while m3-catalog is rasterised by Skiko, so pairing the two would put a RENDERER difference into a comparison meant to be about design. `modes` is a single dark entry because Glimmer draws for an additive display where black is unlit — a light mode is not a thing the hardware can show — and the dark display surface keeps the preview server from staging these captures on white, which the additive-zero ground would vanish into.
title: Compose Glimmer
